messages:
Alyssa: Quick RFC follow-up — I'm proposing a minimal on-prem "plugin-shim" between the operator and the onprem-upgrader so sites can opt into different delivery transports (physical media, private mirror, secure relay) without operator changes.
Marco: can you sketch the surface? what are the required primitives?
Alyssa: minimal primitives: fetch(manifest), verify(signature), stream(blob, offset), apply-checkpoint, preflight-health, abort/rollback hook. keep state machine simple.
Jun: Rollback hook is tricky. If we let plugin decide, operator might not be able to reason about global quorum. Maybe operator needs a deterministic accept/reject and plugin exposes reasons.
Maria: Agreed. What about attestations? We need a way to propagate KMS signatures from customer HSM to operator for audit logs.
Alyssa: idea: plugin returns "verification-proof" blob that operator stores (sha256 + signer metadata). Operator verifies proof schema, not signature validity unless configured.
Marco: That lets airgapped sites do local attestation and operator still holds metadata. :thumbsup:
Jun: Also consider partial apply / chunked-image semantics. Plugins might support range reads. We should define stream API with 'range' param.
Alyssa: example API sketch:
```
GET /v1/plugin/fetch_manifest?image=foo&version=1.2
POST /v1/plugin/stream_blob
body: { "blob_id":"x", "offset": 12345, "length": 8192 }
POST /v1/plugin/verify_signature
body: { "manifest":..., "signer_meta":... }
POST /v1/plugin/report_state
body: { "phase":"preflight|applying|activated|rollback", "details":... }
```
Marco: Should plugin be able to mutate operator DB? probably not. Only push events via report_state.
Maria: What about backward compatibility with old onprem-agent? We should support a shim adapter that proxies old RPCs to new API.
Jun: Edge case: interrupted apply with powercut. Plugin must be able to resume idempotently. Define resume token returned by stream_blob responses.
Alyssa: Resume token + per-chunk checksumming. Operator stores resume token; plugin must honor it.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-deploy onprem-upgrader v2 started for cluster redwood-test-3 :rocket:
Marco: security question: who enforces signature verification? operator or plugin? if plugin, operator must require 'proof' schema to be signed by a trusted CA.
Alyssa: default: operator enforces verification when KMS keys available. If site has private KMS only, operator can accept 'verified-by-plugin' with explicit acceptance flag and store "verified_by_plugin:"true" in audit.
Maria: UX: Console should show last plugin heartbeat and last accepted proof hash. Also show when operator fell back to 'accept-by-override'.
Jun: perf: allow plugin to indicate 'supports_batch_fetch' so operator can parallelize.
Alyssa: action items:
- Marco: draft formal API spec + protobuf contract (including resume token and proof schema) — due EOD Thu
- Jun: define rollback semantics matrix (operator vs plugin responsibilities)
- Maria: console mockups for proof/audit display
- Ops: add canary cluster tag for plugin testing
Marco: ack. I'll start a PR and add examples for physical media vs relay flows.
Alyssa: thanks everyone. feel free to @me for review. closing thread for now :v:
